cues.text: Look at those golden mangoes shining in the sun!
My stomach is already singing a song of hunger.
Let's grab them before someone else beats us to it!
Wait for me! I am the ultimate thief!
I'm at the top! Look at this massive fruit!
Shake the branch! Make it rain mangoes!
Catch this giant one, Teddy!
Oh, pure heaven! So sweet and juicy!
Hey! Who is stealing my prize mangoes?!
Run! It's the angry farmer!
My life flashed before my eyes!
I will find whoever touched my tree!
That was way too close for comfort.
But I still have one mango in my pocket!
Give it here! We need to share our loot!
Oops, I just dropped it in the river!
Oh no! The river stole our breakfast!
I'll dive in and rescue that mango!
Watch out for the giant fish down there!
Eek! That fish looks like a monster!
I survived the river of doom.
Look, there is a basket of apples by the well!
Apples? But we are on a mango mission!
A thief cannot be too choosy, my friend.
Hey thieves! Those apples are for the village fair!
Run away! The whole village is chasing us!
Quick, hide inside this wooden box!
Where did those little rascals go?!
I think the coast is clear now.
We came for mangoes and got chased by a mob.
Let's build a campfire and make tea instead.
Ah, warm tea heals a broken thief heart.
Baa! You are sitting on my favorite rock!
Since when do goats speak human?!
Move before I headbutt your pants off!
Even the animals are against our heist!
Up here, the goats cannot reach our feet!
Look back at the farmer's tree!
The farmer is eating our stolen mangoes himself!
He stole them back from us by accident!
Ah, these mangoes taste like sweet justice!
Well, at least someone is enjoying the fruit.
Next time, we buy our fruit from the store.
Where is the fun in buying things, Peddy?
Woof! I found another hidden mango right here!
A bonus mango?! Our luck has changed!
Best worst heist ever!
